because: arecipe.app is a client-rendered SPA (WebFetch and Playwright could not render/reach it fully); no creator name appears in its manifest, JS bundle strings, or reachable static HTML, so per the crawl-to-confirm rule it can't be confirmed for this new page even though an older doc already names a creator

chose: Added AtChef, Flour Blend Calculator, and Defluffit! to the atproto ecosystem docs; excluded Winesky, Beacon Bits, Arabica, and Plates
because: the user warned 'recipe' can mean non-food things, and vice versa 'food' apps aren't always recipe apps: Winesky is wine/beer/liquor reviews, Beacon Bits is a general location-post pinner, Arabica is coffee brew logging, and Plates is restaurant-menu publishing -- none of them store or share cooking recipes. AtChef/Flour-Blend-Calculator/Defluffit do (confirmed AtChef writes its own eu.atchef.recipe lexicon and Flour Blend Calculator writes exchange.recipe.recipe, both via direct PDS collection inspection over the public atproto API, not just marketing copy)
